title.narrative: Number of Safe Spaces Created or Renovated in PrioritizedCommunities and Households

description.narrative: Arithmetic sum of the integrated spaces projects finalised in a specific year with a minimum value of JMD$1,000,000.00 for each project and that belong to one of the following types: 1. Alternative fencing (Zinc Fence removal & substitution) projects;2. Integrated infrastructure projects (road, water, sidewalk, storm water drainage construction/renovation);3. Improved and supervised recreational and green spaces;4. Safe Passages programmes to support safe commute of children to and from school;5. Transitional shelters for children victims of violence.The projects will be implemented by JSIF in prioritized communities selected from the Community Renewal Programme (CRP) listing as well as other communities as identified by the GOJ based on the Zone of Special Operations (ZOSO) selection.

title.narrative: Reduction in National Perception of Corruption in the Police/JCF

description.narrative: Frequency and percentage distribution.The questions used to determine the perception are based on the average score using international standards for the following question in the JNCVS:What is your perception of corruption within the:a) Local Police (Station)?b) Jamaica Constabulary Force (JCF)?Respondent choose from the following options to determine theextent to which the Police Stations and JCF are corrupt:1. Very Corrupted2. Somewhat corrupted3. Not very corrupted4. Not corrupted at allThe national sample size used is 3480 (using 2016) with the Margin of error / 5%.

title.narrative: Reduction in National Perception of Corruption in the Police/JCF

description.narrative: The indicator aims to determine whether perception of corruptionof the police is decreasing over time using the Jamaica NationalCrime Victimization Survey (JNCVS). This survey is conductedevery three (3) years by the Ministry of National Security. Thisindicator serves to measure the perception of the level of corruptionin the local police stations and the JCF, among respondents.

title.narrative: Number of Parents Trained using Customized Behaviour Change Programmes to Promote Effective Parenting

description.narrative: This indicator assesses the mechanisms in place to strengthen the provision and delivery of parenting services for the households of children from the Primary to Secondary level with maladaptive behaviours island wide. Family members within households will receive behaviour change programmes to develop childrens age appropriate skills through safe caring and nurturing environments to improve childrens social and academic performance.

title.narrative: Status of Governance, Coordinating and Oversight Mechanisms for the implementation of the Citizen Security Plan for Jamaica

description.narrative: The indicator is considered 100% achieved if all the following 3 (three) conditions are met and 50% achieved if only 2 (two) conditions are met:I. Citizen Security Business Group (CSBG): Four (4) Quarterly Meetings with a quorum (50% membership) during the considered fiscal year;II. Citizen Security Secretariat (CSS): Four (4) Quarterly Reports issued and shared with CSBG and CSOC;III. Crime Monitoring and Oversight Committee (CMOC): At least two (2) public statements or press releases on implementation of citizen security matters per fiscal year officially released.

title.narrative: Status of Governance, Coordinating and Oversight Mechanisms for the implementation of the Citizen Security Plan for Jamaica

description.narrative: this indicator will monitor (1) the functioning of the governance structures and institutions charged with the coordinating and monitoring at all levels of the Citizen Security Plan and (2) promote the establishment and functioning of the independent Oversight Committee, providing timely reporting to the public on the progress of implementation of crime and violenceprevention initiatives.
